profile.headline: Software Engineer at Clean Power Research
profile.summary: I am always looking for a challenge and opportunities to learn.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked as a part of an online business software designed for the energy industry. 
Added a feature utilizing Vega to allow customers to create and share visual reports
Followed a mobile first UI design using Vue.js and Bootstrap
Used Vuex for state management on the front end
Moved over multiple pages from being ASPX pages to MVC Razor
Developed and enhanced features for the API and Reporting functionality. 
Following the core principles in a Kanban workflow.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description: Designed, tested and implemented a full stack web based micro service solution. Implemented an in-app metric generation and capture which was then processed in an Apache Spark cluster and visualized with NVD3.

positions.title: Teacher Assistant
positions.description: Aided in teaching the fundamentals of logic, set theory, induction, and limits of computability.

positions.title: Software Engineer Internship
positions.description: Aided in designing and developing services designated by the RFC standards for a cloud-based application with strong mobile emphasis. Used C#, MongoDB and Git.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description: Worked as a summer intern with the Infrastructure Services group. Internship program included participation with the following IS teams; Storage, Production Control and Virtual Machine teams.

educations.fieldOfStudy: Computer Science and Applied & Computational Mathematical Sciences

volunteerExperiences.description: Participated in various activities that involved aiding and assisting my neighborhood by collecting food, creating hiking trails and other community projects.
